title: Twenty Chats at Once
tagline: Twenty AI chats, one desk, and notes that don't wake anyone up.
what: I keep about 20 AI chats open at a time, each on its own piece of work. When one fills up, it writes down where it stopped and a fresh one takes the job from there.
built: Each chat starts knowing which job it's on and where the last one stopped
A mailbox for notes that can wait, so only urgent asks wake another chat
One board shows where every chat stands, with the ones that need me at the top
A handoff that writes down the mission, the state, the traps and the next step
credit: Built it on top of Claude Code
starring: Me, and the AI chats I run every day

making.problem: With about 20 jobs running, I needed to know which ones needed me without reading every chat.

steps.name: Own job
steps.says: Each chat starts knowing its job and what the last chat on it got done.

steps.name: Mail
steps.says: A note that can wait goes in a mailbox. Only do-this-now and questions wake a chat.

steps.name: Handoff
steps.says: A chat that's full writes down where it stopped, and a fresh one picks it up.

moment.what: I look at one board for the chats that need me. The others keep their own jobs, leave notes in the mailbox, and write a handoff when they're full so the next chat starts where they stopped.

scene.cost: Notes wait. Urgent asks come to me.
